description: East Africa Cyclone Flooding - Mozambique is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Designsafe-CI. This study aims to assess disaster risk factors that leave low-income households vulnerable during extreme weather events such as extreme heat and flooding. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher Designsafe-CI. Its tags are Cyclone, Flood, RAPID Facility, Mozambique. The repository dates the deposit 2024; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
